champion.tips: EVELYNN TIPS AND TRICKS Pre-level 6, try and avoid duelling the enemy Jungler. You’re not very strong until you’ve got your Ultimate R and your invisibility. Avoid going for risky picks when your Ultimate R is down. You need it to execute enemies and when it’s down, you’ll find it harder to kill the enemy. Make sure you’re invisible before approaching a lane so you do not get spotted by wards. Ideally, change form while you’re in your jungle.
champion.builds: THE BEST EVELYNN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Evelynn Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Lich Bane as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Rabadon's Deathcap. For your last 3 items, you should build Void Staff, Banshee's Veil and finish with Shadowflame. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 54.7% winrate over 10 902 matches played. Optional Your second option for Evelynn Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Stormsurge, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Shadowflame as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and Banshee's Veil. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 44.3% win rate over 609 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Lich Bane as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Rabadon's Deathcap as a third item. You want to finish the build with Void Staff, Banshee's Veil and Shadowflame. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 51.7% win rate across 590 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Evelynn Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Sudden Impact with Ultimate Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Lich Bane as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Rabadon's Deathcap as third item. The last 3 options are Void Staff, Banshee's Veil and Zhonya's Hourglass. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 54.7% win rate over 225 matches played. Situational Evelynn Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Evelynn build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Evelynn runes page.
